# CodexBarWin <version>

CodexBar for Windows. A native system tray app for Codex usage limits.

## Notes

- Codex-only for now.
- Download `CodexBarWin-<version>-win-x64.exe` and run it directly.
- The release executable is self-contained.
- The app is not code-signed yet, so Windows may show a SmartScreen warning.
- App-owned data stays local under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\CodexBarWin`.
- CodexBarWin is not affiliated with OpenAI.

## Verify Download

The release includes a `.sha256` checksum file for the executable.
